DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') as date, SUM(amount) as amount
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, SUM(amount) as amount
DATE(create_time) as date, SUM(amount) as amount

AND create_time >= #{start}
AND create_time <= #{end}
